title: Caracas Cathedral

terrainReference.basis: Original public elevation on the pedestrian approach from Plaza Bolívar.

mapIdentity.scope: The named five-point cathedral footprint gives the west Plaza Bolívar frontage, long north aisle, and perimeter adjoining the separate Museo Sacro on the south.

note: The original Lessmann view supports the stepped pale masonry facade, bell tower and clay roof hierarchy. The modern inventory supplies five naves, ten north-wall windows and later clock and remodeling details.
